   \[
   \text{kind}(x) \land \text{quiet}(x) \;\Rightarrow\; \text{big}(x)
   \]

   - `kind(x)` must hold **and**  
   - `quiet(x)` must hold.  

   No “or” alternatives are present, so there is **one group** containing exactly these two conditions.
